# Pull Request

Thank you for contributing to the Strutton Technologies ecosystem.  
Please complete the sections below to help reviewers understand your changes.

---

## 🔍 Summary

Provide a clear, concise summary of the changes in this PR.

- What problem does this solve?
- What functionality does it add or modify?

---

## 🧪 Testing

Describe how you tested your changes.

- [ ] Unit tests added or updated  
- [ ] All tests passing locally  
- [ ] Verified with `stp test`  
- [ ] Verified formatting with `stp format -Verify`  

If applicable, include test output or screenshots.

---

## 📦 STP Validation

Confirm the following commands were run before submitting:

- [ ] `stp restore`
- [ ] `stp build`
- [ ] `stp test`
- [ ] `stp coverage` (if applicable)

---

## 🧩 Related Issues

Link any related issues or tickets:

- Closes #
- Related to #

---

## 📁 Code Structure & Guidelines

Confirm the following:

- [ ] Block‑scoped namespaces used  
- [ ] Braces used for all control statements  
- [ ] Partial class structure followed (if applicable)  
- [ ] Test organization follows scenario‑based grouping  
- [ ] No large “mega classes” introduced  

---

## 🤖 Copilot Notes (Optional)

If Copilot assisted with code generation, describe:

- What prompts were used  
- What parts were AI‑generated  
- Any manual adjustments made  

This helps maintain transparency and improves future Copilot guidance.

## 📜 Additional Notes

Add any additional context, concerns, or follow‑up items here.
